sources.title: Government of Aruba, Holidays
sources.said: Holidays: New Year's Day (January 1); Dia di Betico (Betico Day - January 25); Monday before Ash Wednesday ; the National Flag and Anthem Day (March 18); Good Friday; Easter Monday; Ascension Day; King's Day (April 27); Labor Day (1 May); Christmas Day and Boxing Day (December 25 and 26). ... For the year 2026 ... 01 New Year's Day Thursday January 01 02 Dia di Betico (Betico Croes Day) Sunday January 25 03 Carnival Monday Monday February 16 04 National Anthem and Flag day Wednesday March 18 05 Good Friday Friday April 3 06 Easter Monday Monday April 6 07 King's Day Monday April 27 08 Labor Day Friday May 01 09 Ascension Day Thursday May 14 10 Christmas Day Friday December 25 11 Day after Christmas (Boxing day) Saturday December 26 ... For the year 2025 ... 07 King's Day April 27 ...
